newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde July 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government to announce plans to curb public deficit on July 21, the same day as presentation of an audit of public finances is to be unveiled.
-- Elf Aquitaine oil group allegedly took part in providing up to 20 million francs to magazine "Globe-Hebdo" in 1992.

-- Managing director of CDR company set up to sell off Credit Lyonnais assets, Francois Lemasson, calls in an interview for simpler control structures for the CDR, possibly relying on a supervisory board and a board of directors.
